headline: Argentina Enters Technical Recession as Country Risk Hits 13-Month High
summary: Argentina has entered a technical recession following two consecutive quarters of negative GDP growth. The country's risk premium has reached its highest level in 13 months amid fiscal concerns.
why: Argentina's economic instability and high risk premiums impact its ability to access international capital markets and influence regional investment sentiment.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Technical recession and high risk premiums signal economic distress.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
